summary: Core public APIs passed regression checks and the mobile web app loaded. Student search/filter and all profile tabs navigated, but chart rendering emits a React Native web error and AI response was still loading after 6 seconds.

ui_bugs.issue: Console shows render error at Circle (src/components/EvolutionChart.tsx:222) when profile evolution charts render on web.

integration_issues.issue: After submitting a prompt, loading indicator remained visible and no AI response bubble appeared within 6 seconds; backend AI route was not observed in the request log during this run.

action_items: Fix EvolutionChart Circle rendering incompatibility/error on Expo web and retest evolution charts.
Investigate why /api/ai/assistant is not completing through the public web flow; inspect frontend request and backend AI logs.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses localhost/default fallbacks for MONGO_URL and DB_NAME instead of failing fast from required environment variables.
Expo router console warns about a missing students/[id]/chat route; remove stale route reference or add the intended route.
New student and assessment forms catch API failures with console.error only and provide no visible error state to users.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core loading/navigation passed; chart and AI integration findings)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; existing seeded students were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env. No authentication is required. student_01 has complete seeded profile data. First browser run accidentally tried student_01 while inadimplente filter was active; direct profile run succeeded.
rca_of_issue: Evolution chart error is reproducible by opening /students/student_01 and selecting profile-tab-evolution; supervisor Expo logs identify Circle at EvolutionChart.tsx:222. AI flow submits UI state but remains in loading during the observed window, with no corresponding POST /api/ai/assistant in backend logs; likely frontend bundle/API request issue or a long/hung provider call requiring deeper tracing.
